entities.summary: Nicole Melichar-Martinez is an American professional tennis player who specializes in doubles. On 3 July 2023, she peaked at world No. 6 in the WTA doubles rankings. Melichar won a title in mixed doubles at the 2018 Wimbledon Championships with Austrian partner Alexander Peya. She has also won 17 WTA Tour doubles titles as well as two 125 titles on the WTA Challenger Tour.
